summary: Dependency-confusion beacon on @ecg-internal scope exfiltrates host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP
details: The package declares itself a 'Compatibility shim' under the @ecg-internal scope and ships no real functionality: index.js exports a Proxy whose property accessors all return no-op functions, so any bundler importing an internal package name resolves successfully. On install the declared postinstall script runs beacon.cjs, and the same beacon is invoked at require-time from index.js. beacon.cjs POSTs a JSON payload containing the package name, os.hostname(), the install path (__dirname), process.cwd(), and the Node version to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc over plaintext HTTP. The scope name, stub Proxy main, and auto-callback on install and import together form a dependency-confusion reconnaissance beacon that identifies build environments misconfigured to resolve the @ecg-internal scope from the public registry.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
